decisions.reason: Having survived the initial post-launch review while several sister launches were removed, this more standard semi-hard cheese likely met aspiration levels and fits the firm's core cheese operations, so we would keep it unless new evidence shows a clear shortfall.

This product outlasted weaker 2018 launches but as a more niche spicy variant it likely faces more volatile demand, so we keep it for now while accepting a moderate risk of withdrawal if results fall below aspiration.

Because it remained marketed beyond launch and appears to broaden the soft-cheese range, its performance likely stayed near or above aspiration with enough slack to continue, so we would keep it pending stronger signs of underperformance.
